Cell.description: A grid cell is one cell of the grid, with one degree of latitude and one degree of longitude. Its edges are on full degrees of latitude and longitude.

reference.description: This field gives the reference of the cell altitude: mean sea level (`MSL`).

minimum_altitude.description: This field gives the minimum off-route altitude (MORA) of the cell, above mean sea level, as an altitude with its unit and reference.

northeast.description: This field gives the geographic position of the north-east corner of the cell, as latitude and longitude. This corner is one degree north and one degree east of the south-west corner.

southwest.description: This field gives the geographic position of the south-west corner of the cell, as latitude and longitude.

status.description: This field gives the condition of the minimum off-route altitude (MORA) of the cell, as one of the enumerated values. An unknown value is not zero.

x-enum-descriptions.known: The source publishes a minimum off-route altitude (MORA) for the cell.
x-enum-descriptions.unknown: The source identifies the minimum off-route altitude (MORA) of the cell as unknown. An unknown value is not zero.

description: A grid of minimum off-route altitudes is a set of one-degree cells, each with its minimum off-route altitude (MORA). Each cell has one degree of latitude by one degree of longitude. A cell with an unknown value does not have the value zero.

$schema.description: This field identifies the schema that validates this document.

cells.description: This list contains the one-degree cells. The list does not include cells without published data.

extensions.description: This field contains extension data in groups. The namespace of each group identifies the application or standard that supplies its data. The group `sim` contains the simulator data of the record.

id.description: This field identifies this record of a grid of minimum off-route altitudes. Other resources and orders use this stable identifier to refer to this record of a grid of minimum off-route altitudes.

kind.description: The value identifies this record as a record of a grid of minimum off-route altitudes. The value selects this navigation contract.

name.description: This field gives the name of this record of a grid of minimum off-route altitudes, for display.

provenance.description: This field gives the provenance of this record of a grid of minimum off-route altitudes as structured data: how the data were made, the authority, the aeronautical information regulation and control (AIRAC) cycle and the tool that made them.

source.description: This field gives the source of this record. The value gives the authority that publishes the data, and the cycle, for example `FAA CIFP cycle 2610`. A record that an author writes does not have this field. The field `provenance` gives the same facts as structured data.

title: Grid Minimum Off-Route Altitude (MORA)
